facts.text: Caroline mentions that Oliver, her guinea pig, enjoys eating vegetables, specifically parsley.

evidence.quote: He's so cute! What’s the funniest thing Oliver's done? And sure, check out this pic of him eating parsley! Veggies are his fave!

facts.text: Melanie shares that Oliver, her pet, once hid his bone in her slipper.

evidence.quote: Oliver's hilarious! He hid his bone in my slipper once! Cute, right?

facts.text: Melanie recalls an experience where she fed a horse a carrot.

evidence.quote: Almost as silly as when I got to feed a horse a carrot.

facts.text: Caroline shares a memory of horseback riding with her father, describing the experience as special and highlighting her love for horses.

evidence.quote: I used to go horseback riding with my dad when I was a kid, we'd go through the fields, feeling the wind. It was so special. I've always had a love for horses!
